aboutIntro: Movie Night is a small-group film club in your browser: one shared watchlist, scheduled nights, votes, and ratings that stay with your crew.
aboutWhatWeBuild1: Friends who pick films together instead of doomscrolling alone.
aboutWhatWeBuild2: Recurring nights that need a calendar, shortlist, and scoreboard.
aboutWhatWeBuild3: A private space, not a public social network.
aboutOperatorBody: Movie Night is operated solely by {operatorName}. Contact: {email}.
aboutOAuthNote: This About page, our Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service support Google OAuth brand verification and transparent use of Sign-In with Google.
aboutMovieDataBody: Film titles, posters, and overviews are provided by TMDB. Movie Night is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
privacyIntro: Movie Night ("we", "us", or "our") helps small groups plan movie nights, share a watchlist, and rate films together. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can control it. By using Movie Night, you agree to this policy.
privacyWhoWeAreBody: Movie Night is a personal project operated solely by {operatorName}. Contact: {email}.
privacyCollectIntro: Depending on how you sign in and use the app, we may collect:
privacyCollectAccount: Account details: name, email address, and profile photo from Google Sign-In, or your email address when you use email one-time codes.
privacyCollectActivity: App activity: watchlist entries, votes, movie nights, ratings, notes, collections, and related preferences you create in the product.
privacyCollectTechnical: Technical data: basic logs needed to run and secure the service (for example authentication events and error diagnostics).
privacyCollectTmdb: Movie metadata (titles, posters, overviews) is fetched from The Movie Database (TMDB). TMDB content is subject to TMDB's own terms and privacy practices.
privacyUse1: Authenticate you and keep your session secure.
privacyUse2: Provide collaborative features for your movie group.
privacyUse3: Send transactional emails such as sign-in codes and night reminders.
privacyUse4: Maintain, debug, and improve the service.
privacyNoSell: We do not sell your personal information.
privacyGoogleBody: If you choose "Continue with Google," Google shares basic profile information with us (such as your name, email, and profile image) according to your Google account settings. We use that data only to create and manage your Movie Night account. You can revoke access anytime in your Google Account permissions.
privacyProvidersBody: We rely on trusted processors to operate Movie Night, including hosting, database, authentication, and email delivery providers. They process data only to provide their services to us and under appropriate safeguards.
privacyRetentionBody: We keep account and app data while your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data by emailing {email}. Some records may remain briefly in backups or logs as required for security and legal compliance.
privacyChoices1: Update profile information inside the app where available.
privacyChoices2: Disconnect Google access from your Google Account settings.
privacyChoices3: Request access, correction, or deletion by contacting us.
privacyChildrenBody: Movie Night is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
privacyChangesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top will change when we do. Continued use of Movie Night after an update means you accept the revised policy.
termsIntro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Movie Night, operated solely by {operatorName}. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use Movie Night.
termsServiceBody: Movie Night is a collaborative web app for planning movie nights, managing a shared watchlist, voting on films, and recording ratings with a small group. Features may change as we improve the product.
termsAccountsBody: You must provide accurate information when signing in with Google or email. You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping access to your email or Google account secure. Notify us if you suspect unauthorized use.
termsAcceptableUse1: Use Movie Night only for lawful, personal or small-group purposes.
termsAcceptableUse2: Do not abuse, disrupt, or reverse-engineer the service.
termsAcceptableUse3: Do not upload unlawful, harassing, or infringing content.
termsAcceptableUse4: Do not attempt to access another user's account without permission.
termsContentBody: You retain rights to content you submit (such as notes, lists, and ratings). You grant us a limited license to host and display that content so the app can function for you and your group. Movie artwork and metadata from TMDB remain subject to TMDB's terms.
termsThirdPartyBody: Sign-in may use Google and email delivery providers. Movie data may come from TMDB. Those services have their own terms and privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their independent practices.
termsAvailabilityBody: We aim to keep Movie Night available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. We may suspend or discontinue features with reasonable notice when practical.
termsDisclaimerBody: Movie Night is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied, to the fullest extent permitted by law. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.
termsTerminationBody: You may stop using Movie Night at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you violate these Terms or if we need to protect the service or other users. You may request account deletion by contacting {email}.
termsChangesBody: We may update these Terms periodically. The "Last updated" date will change when we do. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms.
metaAboutDescription: Movie Night is a private group app for planning nights, voting on films, and keeping score together.
metaPrivacyDescription: How Movie Night collects, uses, and protects your information when you sign in and use the app.
metaTermsDescription: Terms governing your use of Movie Night for shared watchlists, nights, and ratings.
